sources.lesson: capacity-qualified DHT service subset can exist without consensus authority
malicious service nodes and query capture require local profiles and cross-checks
distinguish query-only clients from record-storing servers
locate replicas/breadcrumbs instead of blindly storing content
disjoint paths and sibling repair are useful under adversarial routing
gardens can steward signed mutable heads but cannot forge them
local/social trust ideas are useful, but rev0005 makes no Sybil-proof claim
